value.rationale: The exact transfer law works for every eligible forbidden bipartite graph, converting potentially intricate sparse independence topology into a dense shortest-path metric complex. Its integral first-persistence-map cancellation is additional structure. The entire family of (n-2)-regular complete-bipartite two-factor complements then has closed homotopy and all-field barcode formulas with a nontrivial mod-three cycle-length dependence. This is an all-parameter operation theorem, not an arbitrary finite slice or an unmotivated numerical gain.
